newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ROMARIO DROPPED AGAIN AFTER MISSING TRAINING.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROMARIO DROPPED AGAIN AFTER MISSING TRAINING.

text.p: Brazilian World Cup striker Romario has been dropped again by Valencia coach Luis Aragones in what many fans are already seeing as punishment for sleeping through a training session.
"Being left out is sad, but I have to get used to it," said Romario on Friday after being told by Aragones he was not in good enough shape to face Sevilla this weekend.
Romario said he did not think his arrival 75 minutes late for training on Thursday was behind the decision.

The Brazilian, whose salary of around 450 million pesetas ($3.5 million) a year makes him Spain's best-paid player, threatened to leave the club after being left out of Valencia's UEFA Cup games against Bayern Munich earlier this season.
